notes.title: Space exploration in the works
notes.notes:
Available in the Official Launch.... Free roam in Deep Space!

We've added the ability to free roam in deep space.  Currently testing 2 types of spacecraft which are vastly different, 1 being large and layered with armor and weaponry, the other fast, evasive and quick to the trigger.   

In deep space you will encounter several different types of enemy space craft and defenses.  You can discover planets to land on and put your boots on the ground.  Each planet has is a unique eco system filled with creatures, some rare and hard to find.  

Each creature provides a Tag when you hunted, beware, some creatures hunt you!
